related.name: Echo Reach
related.desc: Guide an inner joint while a hardware-free pantograph echoes its movement at twice the displacement. Customize the fixed palm tab with local PNG/JPEG relief or verified ASCII/binary STL grips; export ten calibrated assembly parts.

distinction: One input prismatic joint plus a rigid 2:1 length midpoint rocker; unlike dual-slider trammels, two-yoke cranks or approximately straight four-bar couplers. Four lift-apart bed-flat solids and new closure/stop/collision checks.
